title.narrative: HCFC Phase out Management Plan (Stage II)

description.narrative: ..HCFC Phase out Management Plan - Stage II The Government of Mexico has committed to reduce HCFC consumption by 35 per cent of the baseline in 2018, 50 per cent in 2020, and 67.5 per cent in 2022; Activities planned for the HPMP Stage II include policy instruments needed to reduce the supply and/or demand of HCFCs, HPMP coordination and monitoring, updating and operating quota and license systems and legislation customs activities, monitoring HCFC production, public awareness, investment and incentive projects and their impact and costs conversion from HCFC-141b to HFO blowing agent at Whirlpool México, phase out of HCFC-22 and HCFC-141b in aerosol manufacturing in Mexico. Cleaning agent phase out in the refrigeration service sector # phase 2 through a refrigerant management programme, staged phase-out of HCFC-22 production assistance for the introduction of HC alternatives in Mexico (GIZ), strengthening recovery, recycling and reclamation in Mexico (Italy).
